correctness.rationale: In characteristic two, torus tangent-plane parametrization yields A=sx,A′=s/x,B=ty,B′=t/y,C=(1+s+t)xy,C′=(1+s+t)/(xy). Both Q=Z²+AA′+BB′+CC′ and cubic T=ABC′+A′B′C vanish identically. In the dense Z=1 chart, A,A′,B,B′ are independent and T eliminates C′; Q reduces to C²=(AB/A′B′)(1+AA′+BB′), a non-square because ∂/∂A is a nonzero rational function. Thus a 4-dimensional geometrically integral dense open; no dimension-four boundary components on coordinate hyperplanes and codimension-two CM/unmixed CI imply globally integral prime ideal of degree 2×3=6. Source tangent field K=k(x,y,a,b) is purely inseparable degree four over F=k(A,A′,B,B′); image field F(C) is degree two, so tangent-incidence K/F(C) has pure inseparable degree two. Jet c2=12 consistent with 6×2. Independently GF4 enumerated all 63 affine dense-torus Y points, each in parametrized image; finite cases not proof of global assertions.
